title: Canonical Postnikov derived-limit triangle with exact products
statement: Let A be an abelian category with its derived category, countable products and exact countable products. For every K in D(A) and every chosen product of tau_ge(-n)K, the canonical maps from K to these truncations fit into the distinguished Roos triangle K -> product_n tau_ge(-n)K -> product_n tau_ge(-n)K -> K[1], whose middle map is 1 minus the truncation transition shift. No boundedness assumption is imposed.

source.place: definition-derived-limit (Tag 08TC), lemma-products (Tag 07KC), remark-map-into-derived-limit-truncations, and the Postnikov reconstruction argument in the proof of lemma-enough-K-injectives-Ab4-star; the Lean proof uses derived-product existence directly and does not require enough injectives.

proof.text: Use exact countable products to obtain countable products in D(A) and preservation of those products by each homology functor. Complete the Roos transition to a distinguished triangle by derived-limit existence.

On each cohomology degree, the canonical maps to lower truncations are eventually invertible. For an eventually invertible tower, construct a right inverse of 1-shift by forward recursion on its invertible tail and finite backward recursion. The compatible maps identify the original object as the kernel of this split epimorphism. A forward/backward recursion constructs the splitting; this is implemented in the private Lean helpers, rather than left as a new obligation.

Exactness of homology and product comparison identifies the factorization into the completed triangle with an isomorphism on every cohomology object. Reflect isomorphisms in the derived category, and transport the distinguished triangle along this isomorphism, retaining the canonical projection maps.
